method: Manual polygons traced in native photo coordinates from only the supplied actual v2 photograph. Pillow rasterization without resizing or antialiasing. White denotes visible palace roofs/facades; black denotes everything else.
blindness: No targets, reference masks, source renders, camera files, prompts, previous images, or metrics were read for this trace.
included: All visible connected palace roofs and facades, including shadowed faces.
excluded: Open western court floor; large open court; statue; roads; greenery; other city buildings; people and surrounding surfaces.
lightwellAssessment: No clearly separable exposed ground floor was identifiable in the narrow northern roof recesses; the visible windowed vertical faces and roof surfaces were included. Those small boundaries remain uncertain.

uncertainEdges.detail: Western oblique roof edge, minor tree overlaps, and facade foot are manually traced; about 2-4 pixel uncertainty.

North wing fine chimneys, roof ornaments and partially occluded recess edges; about 1-5 pixel uncertainty. Tiny roof recess floors cannot be confidently distinguished from shaded facade/roof at this resolution.
Small tower pinnacles and decorative roof silhouette traced approximately; about 1-4 pixel uncertainty.
Foreground roof ornaments and local facade-base details are approximate, about 1-4 pixels.
Western court boundary retains the shaded walls. Exact ground contact and foreground roof projection have about 2-4 pixel ambiguity.
